# ExpressionCompiler

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Execution.ExpressionCompiler`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Compiles ScriptDom AST expression and condition nodes into executable delegates. Produces closures (PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Execution.CompiledScalarExpression and PPDS.Dataverse.Query.Execution.CompiledPredicate) instead of walking the AST at evaluation time.

Capture source: `a0feb138f00575d35634565f3a733deb9e65ca98`, tree `904cce706d298d3f0ed62ea095bdcdd78d584101` (final-C Release candidate; not a published stable package).


Compiles a ScriptDom Microsoft.SqlServer.TransactSql.ScriptDom.BooleanExpression into an executable predicate delegate.

- Parameter `predicate`: The ScriptDom boolean expression AST node.
- Parameter `aggregateAliasMap`: Optional mapping from aggregate function signatures (e.g. &quot;COUNT(*)&quot;, &quot;SUM(revenue)&quot;) to their output column aliases. When set, aggregate calls resolve as column references.

Returns: A delegate that evaluates the predicate against a row.

Creates a compiler with optional function registry and variable scope accessor. When functionRegistry is null, creates a default registry with all built-in functions.

- Parameter `functionRegistry`: Function registry for dispatching function calls. Null creates a default.
- Parameter `variableScopeAccessor`: Lazy accessor for variable resolution. Null disables variable support.
